interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Huwira e kalaaji ɗin bana ko wanngi nder lilal ngal. To ɓe waɗay ɗum, ɓe ɗo holla lilal ngal be kalmaaji ɗin dow ko wanngi nder lilal ngal.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Ɗum ɓeydii tab naftirki yaago HTML be SVG code blocks. HTML e huuwa page-model-generated nder sandboxed frame je huwira e scripts maaje amma na waawata nastugo Novera, binndiiji maaje, ko bo network; SVG e holla e scripts je wala.
interface.autoGenerateTitle: Ɗum waɗay innde bolle e hoore

interface.primaryDesc: Taski noone aranndeere ngam nandugo nder.
interface.accentDesc: Suɓi kalaaji ɗin naftirteeɗi dow UI.
interface.destructiveDesc: Hokkugo noone ko hollata ngam kuuɗe nyaamnduɗe.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Ɓesda kala darnde fuu yaago ko woni arannde.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Ɗuuɗal ko nandi e maɓɓitiiɗum fuu ɓe waɗiraama yaake ko ɓe waɗata.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Suɓa no bolle hollata to lilal kesum heɓata.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Ɗum hoo’i viewport to lilal ɓaawojum ko mo windi.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Ɗum tokki ko ɗum waɗata ngam jaɓugo haalaji nder wakkati.

hardware.name: Innde
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Huwira e Vulkan API ngam GPU accelerator. Wala huuwa e Vulkan to woodi NVIDIA GPU ngam ɗum waaway wadduki miskilaaji.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Wala GPUs ko yi'a to injiniya llama.cpp. Diidi ɗin e huuwa dow CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: No llama.cpp wolwata e nga GPU?
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: Ɗum GPU Ɗum cenndii kawtal hakkilanki e ngal. CPU — misaaluuji e heɓa gila ko nanndi anndal bano ko lutti nder ɗatal ngal.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: GPU'ji ɗin wayla, ngam non injiniyaaku ɗaɓɓitii. Ɗuuɗal fiiji ɗin ɓeydataama nde ɓe naftira.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: GPU'ji maɓɓitii, amma moodel go'o wonta soynde kuugal. Ɓaɓɓitii ɗum, nden bo tukki Refresh ngam naftirki kesum GPU.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL be port je proxy server.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Taaliiji ngam proxy server, to ɗum yiɗi.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: List je hendidiri be comma je hosts je hauti be proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Hokkugo daliilaaji keɓaaɗi ko bo dillaaɗi. Ɗu'um foti yiɗi ngam woɓɓe-proxy'en goɗɗi amma e ɗustiri seɗɗaaku. Hokkugo ɗum tan to o yardai woɓɓe-proxy'en ɗin.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Tabbitina tabbitinaare SSL wakkati hawtuki e Proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Tabbitina hujjaaji SSL dow nastinaaki nastinaaki.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Tabbitina tabbitinaare SSL dow kawtal peer.

webSearch.title: Tefki Web
webSearch.description: Ɗum waaway hokka moodelji naftoraaki e jannguki Web naftirki kare kuutinirɗe nder Novera.
webSearch.enableDesc: Tabbitinii kuutinirɗe web_search e web_fetch yaago kuutinirɗe ɗe mballita kuutinirɗe ɗen. Kuutinirɗe ɗe mballita kuutinirɗe ɗe wala API key.
webSearch.providerDesc: Suɓii backend laatiingal jaɓata web_search e web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Ɓurna. Hokkugo key {{provider}} API ngam darnde mawndeere e ko heɓaa. Hokkugo ko walaa ngam naftirgo e keywol ngol walaa keerol.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: E ɗum yiɗi. {{provider}} e yiɗi kawtal API ngam heɓtuki wattamji.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Ɓurnaa. Darnde URL je {{provider}}, be JSON API.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Tabbitinii darorde ajentiwol Cowork: darorde maako nde sandbox, e kadin ko yi'etee e ko anndiraa e darorde nde Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Kuuɗe e huwira dow {{backend}}: e ɗe waaway winndee nder nokkuure kuugal tan, boo fiiji nder deftere hoore mum e ɗe waawataa janngee.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Wala sandbox ɗum heɓirta dow ɗatal ngol, ngam non kuutinirgel shell ɗum heɓirtaaka.
cowork.networkDesc: Hokkugo Cowork haalaaji nastina nder network, ngam ko nandi e nastina paketji maabo nastina repository. Hokkugo e default. Hokkugo e main chat shell wala nastina nder network.
cowork.noMemories: Ɗuuɗal miijooji walaa faa hannde. Ɗuuɗal miijooji e ɓesda ɗum e kare kuutinirɗe nder memory_write nde ɓe anndira huunde nde haandi hoositiree.
cowork.noSkills: Ɗuuɗal fiiji ngaɗaaɗi. Fiiji ɗum setwol kuuɗe naftirteeɗe ko moodel foti hawta to ɗum yiɗi.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Go'o nder darnde fuu. Moodiilaaji janngi ɗi'i e kuutinirɗe memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Dabareeji Markdown, e ko waawata e tinndinoore nder YAML. Tinndinoore nde'e woni ko suuraaji yi'ata bako ɓeydaari anndal.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Ngam wallutugo en faamiɗinki Novera, ɗum waaway sennduki bayanuuji ɗi anndaaka bano naftirki fiiji e limta huwooɓe. Min wala hawtuki bolle maaje ko bayanuuji hoore maaje.

privacy.analyticsDesc: Ngam ɓesdaaki Novera, mi yiɗi annduki no ɗum huudaama— amma tan e wallitaaki mi. Mi waaway waylugo ɗum kala sarde fuu.
privacy.privacyPromises: Suɓol maagal wala waylugo ko ɗum waɗata nder ko ɗum waɗata:
privacy.promise1: Hokkuki bolle maɓɓodii e hoore maɓɓodii e dow na'ura maɓɓodiiɗum.
privacy.promise2: Mi wala heɓugo bayanuuji ko haani ko ko haani nder bolle.
privacy.promise3: Ɗuuɗal bayanuuji ɗi fuu maɓɓitiiɗi nden ɓe kawti.
privacy.promise4: Ɗum waaway suɓugo ɗum wakkati fuu ngam o waɗay kuuɗe ɗe o yiɗi.
privacy.promise5: Miɗo holla ko mi hawtata e ko mi heɓata e ko mi heɓata.
